doc: The I20 adoption of the extracted rollup documents for derivation (holon.sorts.reextract): copy to spec/M2/lib/derive_extracted.json once the I19 follow-up's re-extraction is in. SORT-site laws are then re-derived on the extracted facts (reextraction entries: python -m holon.statement_diff reextract --milestone M2 --append), and rule SORT-width derives its laws from the narrowing stores of these documents.
